name: Interference Atlas
tagline: Co-channel spectrum planning with provable bounds.
summary: Models path loss and noise, builds the interference graph, colours it with DSATUR, and uses a maximum clique to prove whether the channel count is minimal. Renders SINR coverage as SVG.

name: Convergence Notes
tagline: Offline-first text sync that survives partitions.
summary: An RGA character tree, an observed-remove tag set with retired tags, vector-clock delta sync and snapshot merges — validated by seeded fuzzing across random network partitions.
